card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle piece of a long medical term, such as the 'cut' in subcutaneous, 'ep' in benzodiazepines or 'vox' in fluvoxamine. Also on some single words like 'vein' or 'injection' within route or drug phrases.

modes.label: Inside route and drug words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long word for an injection route or a drug name.
